title: Authorize rebased CP11c profile registry preparation
goal: Pre-authorize the exact trusted-base and policy-registry preparation needed before moving profile authorities.
acceptanceCriteria: The trusted-base authorization binds the exact transition selector and registry tuples.
The weaken-policy authorization covers only the temporary policy-config directory registrations.
The authorization-only change modifies no trusted component or production policy.
The candidate consumes both authorizations in the same protected diff.
